pages.section_heading: Power the full lifecycle of money in games
pages.section_lead: From real-money rewards and player payouts to peer-to-peer economies, ZBD runs the money lifecycle natively inside your game

pages.title: ZBD Embedded Accounts - Native, licensed financial infrastructure for your game
pages.h1: An Embedded Financial Layer in Your Game.
pages.opening: Programmable financial infrastructure inside your game to power the full money lifecycle: money in, money through, and money out.

pages.title: Introducing ZBD’s Embedded Financial Infrastructure for Games - ZBD Blog
pages.first_sentence: We’re introducing our embedded financial infrastructure for games, giving studios a single platform to power the full money lifecycle.
pages.subhead: A new suite of embedded products gives studios the infrastructure to move money in, through and out of their games, creating a two-way value exchange with players that can drive engagement, revenue and loyalty.
stages: Money in: players fund their in-game balance directly, without leaving the game.
Money through: value moves between players, marketplaces and creator economies.
Money out: players and creators cash out through supported payout methods.
